title: Repeated sequence messages
purpose: Three participants and eight ordered messages, four of them from the client to the API, three of those repeated status requests. Until the sequence layout ships, a Mermaid sequenceDiagram imports as a left-to-right process: messages between the same two participants in the same direction merge into one numbered connection, so every message text and its order stay readable in that one label. This fixture pins that behaviour; a caller has to opt into the sequence layout before it changes.

inputs.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant client as Client app
  participant api as API
  participant store as Data store
  client->>api: Request order
  api->>store: Read stock
  store-->>api: Stock level
  api-->>client: Order accepted
  client->>api: Request status
  client->>api: Request status again
  Note over client,api: Polling continues until the order ships
  loop Every minute
    client->>api: Poll status
  end
  api-xclient: Connection dropped

edges.label: 1. Request order · 5. Request status · 6. Request status again · 7. Poll status

supported: declared participant order, left to right
simplified: messages between the same two participants in the same direction merge into one connection, numbered in source order
a merged connection keeps the line and head of its first message, so the lost message m8, which has no head of its own, is drawn with the dashed line and head of m4
